message: Projects are quicker to work with. New projects can start as a List or a Trip from quick add. A list takes pasted lines one per line, can be shared, and has Uncheck all. Every section has its own Add task, and its header counts all of its tasks, not just today's. Waiting tasks are dimmed. A project's page shows how many are waiting, the trip's dates, and buttons to pull a task or see what's due before you leave. Search results open their project, and search finds recorded answers.
